newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete in $336 mln Bahamas complex deal.
newsitem.headline: Bufete in $336 mln Bahamas complex deal.

text.p: Mexican engineering and construction company, Bufete Industrial SA said on Friday that a joint venture it is in signed a $336 million construction managment agreement with Sun International Hotels Ltd for the construction of Atlantis II, a tourism complex in the Bahamas.
The deal was signed by Crow-Jones/Bufete Construction Co Limited, a joint-venture company formed by Bufete Industrial and Crow-Jones Construction Co Ltd.
Bufete has a 45 percent participation in the joint-venture and because of certain accounting principles will only record its fee.
The project is scheduled to be completed by the end of October 1998, it said.

The project includes the management and coordination of all procurement and construction works for the renovation of an existing casino as well as the construction of a 1,200 room hotel complex and related site work.
